prompt: Bug report from a user: "Track files exported from my Garmin app fail with `trailhead: line 1: expected the header 'lat,lon,ele'`, but when I open one in my editor the first line is exactly `lat,lon,ele`. One of the files is attached as `garmin-export.csv`." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git status --short && git ls-files && ls -la && head -c 300 garmin-export.csv | od -c | head -20
grep -rn "expected the header\|lat,lon\|utf\|encoding\|open(\|csv\|BOM\|newline" src tests | head -60; echo ---; cat src/trailhead/track.py

(python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15); PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from trailhead.track import load_track
t=load_track('garmin-export.csv'); print(t.name, len(t.points), round(t.length_km(),3))"; python3 -m ruff check src tests 2>&1 | tail -3

PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from trailhead.track import load_track
t=load_track('garmin-export.csv'); print(t.name, len(t.points), round(t.length_km(),3))"
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2; (python3 -m ruff check src tests 2>&1 || true) | tail -3
